text:
nora: quick heads-up — after rolling sticky-routing global I'm seeing resumed sessions in eu-west show up under ap-northeast in the deduped dashboard. counts look lower in eu-west and higher in ap-northeast. billing doesn't match. Anyone?

chen: that's worrying. Are we using a global dedupe key? I thought we included region in the hash.

patrick: we recently reverted the region prefix to shrink tag cardinality. that likely caused cross-region collisions when resume_token duplicates existed from infra tests.

irene: if the dedupe key collides across regions, the console can misattribute resume successes to the wrong region. billing uses per-customer token+region so it looks off.

nora: can we quick revert? I don't want customers to see charges move regions.

chen: propose urgent patch: change dedupe key to include "region|resume_token|10s_bucket" and emit as "reconnect_dedupe_v2". keep old metric for 24h for comparison.

patrick: pipeline caveat: adding region back increases tag cardinality. telemetry will sample and may delay ingestion. infra: do we have capacity to accept the extra tag for a short window?

observability-bot: deploy-note: sticky-routing global rollout rl-2026-03-24-01.

irene: console UX: product suggested an explicit toggle 'dedupe scope: global | regional' with a tooltip. avoid surprise by defaulting to regional dedupe for now.

product: agreed. also include a banner "observability metric behavior changed" and a small changelog entry. do not swap the default until metrics validated.

chen: quick code change (Go):
```go
key := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%d", region, resumeToken, ts/10)
h := sha1.Sum([]byte(key))
dedupeID := hex.EncodeToString(h[:])[:12]
metrics.Count("ws.reconnect.dedupe.v2", 1, map[string]string{"dedupe_id": dedupeID, "region": region})
```

patrick: filed infra ticket PLAT-4201 to allow the dedupe.v2 tag through the pipeline for 48h and PLAT-4202 to cap sampling for that window.

nora: alerting: mute current reconnect surge alert and create a temp alert on "billing.resume_successes" with annotation "region-dedupe in flight". I'll mute for 2h.

observability-bot: alert muted: ws_reconnect_surge by nora (2h).

chen: rollout plan: feature flag "reconnect_dedupe_scope" default regional, run global-staging 100% to exercise CI, then eu-west canary 100% for 1h and check dedupe_region_ratio panels.

irene: console change: add "experimental: dedupe scope" toggle and a compare panel `dedupe_v2/dedupe_v1` with ratio. product will craft tooltip.

nora: owners: nora -> mute & ops playbook, chen -> code + PR, patrick -> infra tickets, irene -> console toggle + banner, product -> customer comms.

nora: thanks all. will unmute if numbers stabilize.

patrick: follow-up: avoid flipping historical panels; create a separate "deduped-regional-v2" panel marked experimental.

chen: sending PR now.

nora: closing loop — will post incident note and link tickets.
